messages.author: b2d9d2614971143c
messages.subject: kernel argument in pkde function
parts:
Hi Chris,

Could you give an example case of when you would choose the kernel = "population" option in the pkde function over the default kernel = "individual"? I'm trying to get a better sense of how this behaves and when it would be appropriate to use.

Best,
Christina

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: kernel argument in pkde function
parts:
Hi Christina,

This will be in the incoming methods paper, but in our testing so far kernel='population' does not work better - even in the cases where I thought it should have an advantage.
Given that it is slower to calculate, I don't see any reason to use it at present. More features are coming, so it might become useful one day.

Best,
Chris
